description: Schema for a letter of intent to acquire a business or its assets, as used in M&A and utility acquisition files. Captures the deal points of the letter itself and summarizes any definitive purchase agreements bundled with it.

letter_of_intent.description: The letter of intent itself: its date, parties and deal points.

title.description: Document title as printed (e.g., Letter of Intent).

letter_date.description: Date of the letter of intent as printed at the top, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

subject.description: The Re: or subject line describing the proposed transaction.

buyer_name.description: Legal name of the proposed buyer (the party issuing the letter).

buyer_state_of_organization.description: State under whose laws the buyer is organized (e.g., Missouri).

target_name.description: Name of the business or seller whose assets are to be acquired.

target_business_description.description: What the target business is or does (e.g., regulated sewer utility).

target_location.description: County and state where the target operates.

transaction_structure.description: Whether the deal is an asset purchase or a stock/equity purchase.

purchase_price.description: Proposed purchase price in US dollars, as a number.

purchase_price_basis.description: How the purchase price was determined or may be adjusted (e.g., estimate of net book value, subject to adjustment).

closing_date_terms.description: How the closing date is set (a fixed date, or e.g. a date mutually agreed by the parties).

assets_included.description: Categories of assets the buyer is to acquire, one entry per listed category.

excluded_assets.description: Assets expressly excluded from the sale (e.g., cash and bank deposits, pre-closing receivables).

conditions_of_sale.description: Conditions that must be satisfied before closing, one entry per condition.

assumes_seller_debts.description: True if the buyer agrees to assume the seller's debts and obligations; false if it expressly does not.

due_diligence_period_days.description: Number of days the buyer has to complete its investigation and evaluation before the letter expires.

exclusivity_terms.description: Summary of any no-shop or exclusivity commitment by the seller and how long it lasts.

binding_sections.description: Section numbers of the letter stated to be binding; the rest of the letter is non-binding.

acceptance_signatories.description: Organizations that signed or accepted the letter, with the signer's title.

signer_title.description: Title of the person signing for the organization.

related_agreements.description: Definitive purchase agreements or other agreements included in the same file, one entry per agreement.

agreement_title.description: Title of the agreement as printed.

agreement_date.description: Date the agreement is made as of, in YYYY-MM-DD format if legible.

purchase_price.description: Purchase price stated in the agreement, in US dollars.

governing_law_state.description: State whose law governs the agreement.
